resources.string: Save local encrypted snapshots before deletion, media expiry and message edits. Off by default; enabling applies to future events for this account. This version saves text and message data, but does not save original media files. Up to 2,000 snapshots per account, with older snapshots removed first. Disabling keeps existing snapshots. Nothing is sent to another server.
